text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was doing strength 
training together with Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it. It was just a 
slight headache.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna gripped the dumbbell so hard 
that it broke into pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...You're exaggerating. Something like 
this is nothing to me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, tensing up without realizing it is 
somewhat inconvenient, isn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna seems to be suffering from a 
migraine so severe that she can't even 
regulate her own strength...
